protocol.guard: If the public context freshness statement says later archives are unchecked, skip decision and retrieve. Otherwise ask the model; require retrieval before a direct UNKNOWN answer or after invalid JSON/answer schema. Never use gold answers or required source IDs in the guard.
protocol.scoring: Registered primary JSON answer accuracy plus separate factual-only score; all paired regressions, source coverage, skip errors and all call costs retained.
protocol.scope: Dense static paired contexts; 120 interleaved entities per seed, every record carries a fact or provenance/decoy. Long records include repeated observations to stress excerpt selection. No model-generated fixture or new dynamic trajectory. Known lexical multi-hop limits are intentionally included. Source list is bounded identically across arms; compact does not add facts.
protocol.gate: Do not change production defaults or claim statistical non-inferiority from this one exploratory run.
